<thought>Analyzing the isotopic pattern: the dominant peak at m/z 114.07 (intensity 100) is followed by a clear M+1 peak at ~6.7 % intensity, consistent with ~6 carbon atoms (≈1.1 % × 6). The subsequent M+2, M+3, etc., are orders of magnitude smaller, matching the expected low‑abundance multi‑13C contributions and showing no characteristic 33 % M+2 pattern of chlorine, 1:1 pattern of bromine, or ~4 % M+2 of sulfur. Thus only carbon can be definitively identified from the observed isotope distribution.
